reports.title: MUELLER WATER PRODUCTS REPORTS RECORD FOURTH QUARTER AND FULL YEAR 2026 RESULTS; INTRODUCES FISCAL 2027 GUIDANCE

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: The Company is introducing fiscal 2027 consolidated net sales guidance of $1,440 million to $1,470 million. This guidance excludes all metering-related financial results. In fiscal 2026, the metering-related net sales were approximately $40 million. The Company anticipates its fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA to be between $378 million and $388 million. At the midpoint of the guidance range, the Company expects to achieve an adjusted EBITDA margin of 26.3% for the year, reflecting a 110 basis point year-over-year improvement. The Company anticipates the second half of fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA margin will be higher than the first half, driven primarily by the seasonality of net sales, benefits from portfolio optimization and operational improvements. The Company expects free cash flow as a percentage of adjusted net income to be more than 80% in fiscal 2027.
The Company’s expectations for certain additional financial metrics for fiscal 2027 are as follows:
•Total SG&A expenses between $228 million and $233 million
•Net interest expense between $3 million and $5 million
•Depreciation and amortization between $48 million and $52 million
